value: CausalBench 1.1.2 rules regenerated from that package's own code: strong-perturbation filter, 10th-percentile knockdown filter, more than 100 cells per perturbation, `sklearn.train_test_split(random_state=0, stratify=perturbation)`. The filtered dataset was not downloaded; regenerating it is what fixes the perturbation order and therefore every downstream checksum.
422 K562 essential-gene perturbations, day 6, their own held-out cells, profiles centred on their own control (C_ref, 6,553 cells). `reference.npz` MD5 `5541e45a72a0`. Never refitted.

the K562 genome-wide screen (1,989,578 cells, 8,248 genes, 9,866 perturbations) streamed from its 61.3 GiB public h5ad by HTTP range requests; per-perturbation cells permuted once with a seed derived from `SHA256("pertrescue-stage6-v1\|gwps\|<gene id>")`; positions 0 to 19 form the 20-cell input, 0 to 49 the 50-cell input, 50 onward the evaluation profile (median 178 cells).
perturbations with at least 150 cells and no reference entry, the first 2,000 in hash order; the 266 with a reference entry form a separate shared set, never pooled.
C_input 2,000 non-targeting cells in hash order (disjoint from C_ref); C_test the remaining non-targeting cells, used only to centre the truth.
the 8,202 genes shared by the reference and the genome-wide export, in reference order.
